thread:
inc-bot: Pager: HIGH error rate detected for /v1/generate on prod (region-us-east-1). 5xx spike starting ~2026-03-15T10:02:10Z, current 5xx ~18% of traffic, 429s also increasing. Alert: https://alerts.redwood.example/INC-4467891234 :rotating_light:

alex (sre): oncall please? looks like a cascade, many customers reporting timeouts via support.

sam (eng-oncall): i'm up, joining. pulling logs now. anyone see recent deploys?

maria (infra): no deploys in the last 2 hours from deploy-bot. infrastructure telemetry shows rate-limiter (rl-service) has sharp token drops at 10:01:30Z.

sam (eng-oncall): copying logs:
```
10:01:29Z rl-service WARN applyQuotaPolicy tenant=ten-42 policy=GLOBAL_STRICT rejected=1200
10:01:30Z gateway ERROR downstream timeout backend=runtime-01 reason=kv-cache-miss
10:01:31Z gateway 429 tenant=ten-42 route=/v1/generate quota_exceeded
10:01:32Z gateway 503 downstream overloaded conn_reset
```

alex (sre): hmm 429s then 503s = classic quota misapply -> fanout into overloaded downstream. maybe the rate-limiter propagated a stricter global policy accidentally. any config pushes?

maria (infra): i see a rollout of a config-change to rl-service at 10:00:55Z from infra-ci: `rl-config:global/enforce=true, global/limit=0.8` — looks like a mistaken value. 10:01:00 rollout to all regions.

jordan (prodops): that matches customer complaints. CS reports tenant ten-42 had a heavy job at 10:02. With global strict, their retries bubbled causing downstream overload.

sam (eng-oncall): mitigation plan: 1) revert rl-config to previous (global/enforce=false) 2) add immediate per-tenant emergency override for ten-42, 3) enable fallback routing to secondary runtime pool to shed load. I'll run step 1 now.

sam (eng-oncall): running rollback:
```
# rollback command
infra-cli rl-service apply --target=prod --file=rl-config-prev.yaml --dry-run=false
```

inc-bot: Deploy started by sam (eng-oncall) at 10:05:12Z.

maria (infra): i'm patching per-tenant override for ten-42 to 10x allowed tokens until we stabilize.

alex (sre): applying fallback routing to secondary pool (southamerica) for non-pinned customers to reduce pressure on runtime-01.

sam (eng-oncall): rollback completed at 10:06:00Z per deploy logs. rl-service now reporting policy=enforced=false on leaders.

maria (infra): per-tenant override applied. relay shows ten-42 token bucket increased.

sam (eng-oncall): metrics after actions: 10:07:00Z 5xx down to 6%, 429s dropping. latency slowly returning.

jordan (prodops): notifying affected customers: CS to send template with status and mitigation note. CS @cs-rep please copy incident update.

cs-rep: sending initial customer update now.

alex (sre): notes for post-incident: - root cause: bad rl-config rollout (global/enforce set true) - propagation to all regions caused token starvation for heavy tenants - retries and retry fanout overloaded runtime causing 503s - quick mitigation: rollback, per-tenant emergency override, fallback routing - follow-ups: add rollout guard for rl-config, automatic canary + watch, rate-limiter sanity check that rejects dangerous global limits.

maria (infra): creating follow-up tickets: INFRA-2241 (rollback postmortem), INFRA-2242 (canary+guard), INFRA-2243 (better per-tenant isolation).

sam (eng-oncall): handing over to night oncall @alex (sre) for monitoring for 4 hours. i'm going offline but remain on text if needed.

alex (sre): taking handoff. i'll watch error rate and latency dashboards, set alert thresholds tighter for next 6 hours.

inc-bot: Incident INC-4467891234 acknowledged by alex (sre). Pager duty notes: severity=P2, incident lead=sam, handoff_to=alex.

jordan (prodops): quick customer impact estimate: ~12 customers saw transient 5xx during the spike, 3 enterprise customers had degraded SLA windows, CS working with them for credits.

sam (eng-oncall): final operational note: we should consider a short-term change to disable automatic global policy rollouts until canary pipelines validated configs. also add an emergency-unwind playbook for rl-config. :warning:

alex (sre): agreed. i'll draft the playbook and own the postmortem. assigning action: alex -> PM for rollout policy changes, maria -> infra tickets, sam -> test harness for rate-limiter canaries.

cs-rep: customers notified, tickets opened with affected accounts.

maria (infra): logs archived under s3://incidents/4467891234/ for postmortem.

sam (eng-oncall): thanks team. closing active mitigation; monitoring in place.

alex (sre): closing thread for active ops. will reopen for postmortem notes. :white_check_mark:
